div.head:
2379. Robert Southey to Grosvenor Charles Bedford, 18 February 1814Endorsement: R.S. 18. Feby. 1814
MS: Bodleian Library, MS Eng. Lett. c. 25. ALS; 2p.
Unpublished.
div.p: You have here two books of Roderick, MSS drafts of Roderick, the Last of the Goths (1814). – let the Docstor have them as soon as you can. – And when you have cast your eye over the Ode Probably ‘Ode Written During the Negotiations with Bonaparte’, published in the Courier, 3 February 1814. (if you have not seen it before) put a cover upon it, & dispatch it by the three-penny post to Streatham, – to my Uncle for whom I have thus transcribed it.

I x am looking every day for Rosenhagens frank A frank used to send MSS books of Roderick; it came courtesy of Anthony Rosenhagen (1778–1854), financial expert and friend of Landor. He started life as a junior civil servant, but rose swiftly to be private secretary to the Chancellor of the Exchequer 1811–1815. with the former books, – pray send them with as little delay as can be made to suit your convenience, – for the printer is close upon them, & they will require a few days of reconsideration here.
The 14th book Of Roderick, the Last of the Goths. is finished but not transcribed
